title: Create and apply a migration in one command
goal: Generate a named local migration and apply it to an explicitly selected development database while retaining the generated source files.

selectionNotes: Generate a named local migration and apply it to an explicitly selected development database while retaining the generated source files.

evidence.scope: EF10 two-step scaffold/apply, manual removal of known-unpublished first-migration files, real SQL history/schema, retained model/index and accepted orphan insert. No EF11, PMC or GA execution.

EF11 combined add/apply with retained generated files, real SQL history/schema, retained model/index and accepted orphan insert. humanProof.scope: Agent-executed dotnet-ef route only; Visual Studio PMC execution remains PIN-957. Current GA records define measured coverage and retained exclusions.
